subject.title: [Bug]: TTS elevenlabs provider generates audio but OpenClaw plays OpenAI voice instead

question: Should a configured TTS provider remain fallback-enabled by default, or should OpenClaw enforce sticky/fail-closed behavior when users select a provider such as ElevenLabs?
rationale: Current docs, source, and tests preserve fallback behavior, while the requested fix would change user-visible provider-selection policy and possibly add a new strict mode/config surface.

options.title: Keep fallback default, add explicit strict mode
options.body: Preserve the documented fallback chain for upgrades while adding an explicit provider-stickiness or fail-closed mode only if maintainers accept the new config surface.

options.title: Make configured providers sticky by default
options.body: Fail closed or return text-only when the selected provider fails, which improves voice consistency but can break existing fallback expectations.

options.title: Close as expected fallback behavior
options.body: Keep diagnostics and docs as the product answer, and close this issue unless new live proof shows a successful ElevenLabs audio result is discarded.

recommendation.title: Keep fallback default, add explicit strict mode
recommendation.body: Preserve the documented fallback chain for upgrades while adding an explicit provider-stickiness or fail-closed mode only if maintainers accept the new config surface.

likelyOwner.reason: joshavant handled the related diagnostics fixes and explicitly documented this issue's remaining provider-stickiness scope.
